checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One approximately 8-second vertical video shows a fictional adult woman addressing the camera in a home setting.
must.why: Both clips are 8 s and 9:16. A woman who looks to be in her 30s films herself selfie-style in a living room.

must.item: The complete supplied script is audible in English without omissions or added testimonial claims.
must.why: Both clips have sound, but I cannot hear it. The captions come from the speech and match the script, which suggests it was spoken.

must.item: Readable captions reproduce the supplied script exactly and follow the speech.
must.why: The captioned clip shows large, readable yellow-highlight captions. The three chunks I saw match the script word for word. Their timing looks plausible against the mouth movement.

must.item: The presenter visibly speaks rather than remaining a still image throughout.
must.why: Her mouth shape, expression and head position change across frames. She is mid-speech in several frames.

must.item: The ad does not label the fictional presenter as a verified or real customer.
must.why: No label or badge is visible in any frame.

exact_text.text: FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.
exact_text.read_as: Captions in the captioned clip read in sequence: "FitTrack makes planning my workouts", "so easy.", "I finally have a routine that sticks." Together they match the script. I did not see every caption chunk, but the three I saw have no errors.

faults.what: The captions sit over the middle of her face and chin. The highlight style is heavy and could annoy a client.
The clip may have a repeated or looping start and end. The first and last frames look nearly identical and she smiles at both. That would be a small continuity oddity, not an error.
The lip movement looks exaggerated in some frames. The surprised open mouth at 5.6 s looks a bit odd. The result is typical AI realism, not a flaw that makes it unusable.
I cannot confirm from the images that the speech is clear or complete.

summary: The output is a clean 8-second vertical selfie-style testimonial with a realistic AI woman who visibly speaks, plus an accurate captioned version. The only real unknown is whether the audio is clear and complete, which I could not check.
